Shiraiwa is a Japanese professional baseball pitcher for the Hanshin Tigers.

Early life and career

Shiraiwa was born on October 12, 1992, in Toyokawa, Aichi Prefecture. He began playing baseball at a young age and played for Toyohashi Minami High School. After graduating from high school, he was drafted by the Hanshin Tigers in the sixth round of the 2010 NPB draft.

Professional career

Shiraiwa made his debut in the Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) league in 2011. He spent his first few seasons in the minors, developing his skills. In 2014, he made his first appearance in the NPB first team. He quickly became a key member of the Tigers' pitching rotation.

In the 2015 season, Shiraiwa recorded a 3.08 ERA in 25 games played, with a record of 8 wins and 4 losses. He continued to be a reliable pitcher for the Tigers in the following seasons. In 2019, he was selected for the NPB All-Star Game for the first time in his career.

Personal life

Shiraiwa is married and has one child. He is known for his quiet and humble demeanor.
